translations.idiomatic: Four Manchu and four Han Banner each.

sentences.zh: 統領掌九門管鑰，統帥八旗步軍五營將弁，以周衛徼循，肅靖京邑。

translations.literal: The commander-in-chief held the keys of the Nine Gates, commanded Eight-Banner infantry and the five patrol camps' officers, patrolled the defenses, and kept the capital tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: The commander-in-chief held Nine Gates keys, commanded banner infantry and patrol-camp officers, and kept the capital secure.

translations.literal: Major-generals assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: Major-generals assisted.

sentences.zh: 郎中各官掌勾檢簿書，平決諍訟。

translations.literal: Directors and other officers audited documents and settled disputes.
translations.idiomatic: Directors audited documents and settled disputes.

sentences.zh: 司務掌典守檔冊，計會俸饟。

translations.literal: Registrars kept archives and accounted for pay.
translations.idiomatic: Registrars kept archives and accounted for pay.

sentences.zh: 翼尉各官掌分轄步軍，守衛循警。

translations.literal: Wing commandants commanded infantry subdivisions for guard and patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Wing commandants commanded infantry guard and patrol.

sentences.zh: 城門領掌司門禁，稽查出入。

translations.literal: Gate wardens controlled gates and inspected entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: Gate wardens controlled gates and inspected traffic.

sentences.zh: 巡捕營各官掌分汛防守，巡邏糾察，以執御非違。

translations.literal: Patrol-camp officers defended their sectors, patrolled, and investigated to suppress violations.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol-camp officers defended sectors, patrolled, and suppressed violations.

sentences.zh: 信砲總管掌有警奉金牌聲眾。

translations.literal: The signal-gun superintendent, when alarm arose, sounded the signal with the gold placard.
translations.idiomatic: The signal-gun superintendent sounded alarms with the gold placard.

sentences.zh: 初置步軍統領一人，左、右翼總尉各一人，乾隆十九年改翼尉。

translations.literal: At first one infantry commander-in-chief and one left and right wing chief commandant each were placed; in the nineteenth year of Qianlong changed to wing commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Initially one infantry commander-in-chief and left and right chief commandants; in Qianlong 19 they became wing commandants.

sentences.zh: 步軍校，八旗滿、蒙參領下各四人，漢軍各二人；

translations.literal: Infantry corporals — four each under Manchu and Mongol regimental commanders, two under Han Banner;
translations.idiomatic: Infantry corporals: four each under Manchu and Mongol regimental commanders, two under Han Banner;

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong changed to infantry commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 19 renamed infantry commandants.

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 restored.

sentences.zh: 並定巡捕二營，置參將以次各官。

translations.literal: Two patrol camps were also fixed, with colonels and lower ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Two patrol camps were fixed with colonels and lower ranks.

sentences.zh: 以兵部職方司漢主事一人司政令。

translations.literal: One Han section chief of the Board of War's Operations Bureau handled government orders.
translations.idiomatic: One Han Operations Bureau section chief handled orders.

sentences.zh: 京城內九門、外七門，置指揮、千百戶隸之。

translations.literal: For the nine inner gates and seven outer gates of the capital, commanders and centurions were placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: Nine inner and seven outer gates had commanders and centurions under him.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, changed to gate battalion chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 they became gate battalion chiefs.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，置步軍副尉，滿、蒙、漢軍，旗各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi, infantry deputy commandants were placed — one each for Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 5 one infantry deputy commandant was added per banner type.

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong, changed to coordinating commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 19 they became coordinating commandants.

sentences.zh: 十年，允尚書噶洪達請，設白塔山及內九門信砲各五，置漢軍信砲官左、右翼各二人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, at Minister Gahangda's request, signal guns were set at White Pagoda Hill and the inner nine gates — five each — with two Han Banner signal-gun officers per wing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10, per Minister Gahangda, signal guns were placed at White Pagoda Hill and the inner nine gates with Han signal officers per wing.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年更名，並定員限。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng renamed and quotas fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 they were renamed and quotas fixed.

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong they came under this jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8 they came under this command.

translations.literal: Quotas as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas as listed above.

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, central-camp patrol officers were placed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 central-camp patrol officers were added.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，始命步軍統領提督九門事務，並定城門尉、城門校，乾隆十九年改城門領、城門吏。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, the infantry commander-in-chief was first ordered to supervise Nine Gates affairs; gate commandants and gate corporals were fixed — in Qianlong 19 renamed gate wardens and gate clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 the infantry commander-in-chief took Nine Gates affairs; gate commandants and corporals were fixed — renamed gate wardens and clerks in Qianlong 19.

sentences.zh: 內九門俱各二人，外七門俱各一人，千總門各二人，以統轄十六門門軍。

translations.literal: Two each for the inner nine gates, one each for the outer seven; two battalion chiefs per gate — to command gate soldiers of the sixteen gates.
translations.idiomatic: Inner nine gates: two each; outer seven: one each; two battalion chiefs per gate commanded sixteen-gate soldiers.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，八旗滿、蒙各參領下增委署步軍校一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, one acting infantry corporal was added under each Manchu and Mongol regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 each Manchu and Mongol regimental commander gained one acting infantry corporal.

sentences.zh: 三十四年定八旗滿洲各五人，蒙古、漢軍各二人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, fixed at five Manchu each and two Mongol and Han Banner each.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34: five Manchu each; two Mongol and Han Banner each.

sentences.zh: 三十年，覆命步軍統領兼管巡捕三營。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, the infantry commander-in-chief was again ordered to concurrently manage the three patrol camps.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 the commander-in-chief again managed three patrol camps.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，增捕盜步軍校四十人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, forty bandit-catching infantry corporals were added.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 forty bandit-catching infantry corporals were added.

translations.literal: Selected from infantry corporals.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen from infantry corporals.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，置滿洲員外郎一人。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year, one Manchu vice director was placed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 61 one Manchu vice director was added.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，置步軍參尉，乾隆十九年改副尉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, infantry assistant commandants were placed; in the nineteenth year of Qianlong changed to deputy commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 infantry assistant commandants were added; in Qianlong 19 they became deputy commandants.

translations.literal: One each for Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: One each for Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，簡部臣一人協理刑名。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, one board minister was specially chosen to assist in criminal matters.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 one board minister assisted in criminal matters.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十三年省步軍統領，由都統、副都統授者仍置。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Qianlong the infantry commander-in-chief was abolished; those appointed from commanders-in-chief and deputies still retained the post.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 the infantry commander-in-chief was cut; appointees from banner commanders retained the title.

sentences.zh: 明年，增滿洲員外郎一人，置主事二人。

translations.literal: The next year, one Manchu vice director was added and two section chiefs placed.
translations.idiomatic: The next year one Manchu vice director and two section chiefs were added.

sentences.zh: 十三年，置滿洲司務一人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, one Manchu registrar was placed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 one Manchu registrar was added.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，以三營轄境遼廓，增設左、右二營，是為五營，並置副將各官。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, because the three camps' jurisdictions were vast, left and right camps were added — making five camps — with deputy generals and other officers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 46 left and right camps were added to the three, forming five camps with deputy generals.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，增左、右翼總兵各一人，郎中一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, one major-general and one director were added to each wing.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 each wing gained a major-general and a director.

translations.literal: In the ninth year, two deputy wing commandants were added.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 two deputy wing commandants were added.

sentences.zh: 火器營掌印總統大臣一人。

translations.literal: Firearms Battalion — one seal-holding overall supervising minister.
translations.idiomatic: Firearms Battalion: one seal-holding overall supervising minister.

translations.literal: Overall supervising ministers had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Overall supervising ministers had no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 王、公、侍衛內大臣、都統、前鋒護軍統領、副都統內特簡。

translations.literal: Specially selected from princes, dukes, bodyguard grand ministers, commanders-in-chief, vanguard and guard commanders, and deputy commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen from princes, dukes, bodyguard grand ministers, and banner commanders.

translations.literal: Inner and outer camp wing chiefs — regular third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer camp wing chiefs — regular third rank.

translations.literal: Acting wing chiefs and camp chiefs — regular third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Acting wing chiefs and camp chiefs — regular third rank.

translations.literal: One each;
translations.idiomatic: One each;

translations.literal: Three camp chiefs each.
translations.idiomatic: Three camp chiefs each.

sentences.zh: 鳥槍護軍參領各四人，正三品。

translations.literal: Four musket guard regimental commanders each — regular third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four musket guard regimental commanders each — regular third rank.

translations.literal: Deputy regimental commanders doubled that — regular fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy regimental commanders doubled the quota — regular fourth rank.

translations.literal: Acting regimental commanders doubled again.
translations.idiomatic: Acting regimental commanders doubled again.

translations.literal: Subordinate fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate fifth rank.

translations.literal: Musket guard corporals — regular sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Musket guard corporals — regular sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 藍翎長，俱各百十有二人。

translations.literal: Blue-plume chiefs — one hundred twelve each.
translations.idiomatic: 112 blue-plume chiefs each.

sentences.zh: 協理事務翼長、署翼長、營總各一人，鳥槍護軍參領四人，俱以內營人員兼充。

translations.literal: One wing chief, one acting wing chief, and one camp chief each for assisting in affairs, and four musket guard regimental commanders — all filled concurrently from inner-camp personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-camp personnel concurrently filled one wing chief, one acting wing chief, one camp chief, and four musket guard regimental commanders for affairs.

translations.literal: Ten acting regimental commanders on upper duty.
translations.idiomatic: Ten acting regimental commanders on upper duty.

sentences.zh: 以協理參領不敷督率，增內營三人、外營七人。

translations.literal: Because coordinating regimental commanders were insufficient to supervise, three inner-camp and seven outer-camp were added.
translations.idiomatic: Three inner-camp and seven outer-camp were added when coordinating regimental commanders proved insufficient.

translations.literal: Sixteen clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen clerks.

sentences.zh: 總統掌教演火器政令，遴滿、蒙兵習其藝者別為營，分內、外，以時較試。

translations.literal: The overall supervisor managed firearms-drill government orders, selected Manchu and Mongol troops skilled in the art for separate camps, inner and outer, with timed trials.
translations.idiomatic: The overall supervisor managed firearms drill, formed inner and outer camps of skilled Manchu and Mongol troops, and held timed trials.

sentences.zh: 其御河旁一營，兼督水軍習楫棹，巡幸則備扈從。

translations.literal: One camp beside the Imperial River also supervised naval troops practicing oars; on tours it provided escort.
translations.idiomatic: One Imperial River camp also trained naval oarsmen and provided tour escort.

translations.literal: Wing chiefs and other officers commanded subdivisions in training.
translations.idiomatic: Wing chiefs commanded training subdivisions.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十七年，設漢軍火器兼練大刀營，置總管、翼長各一人，副都統兼管。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi, a Han Banner firearms camp also practicing broadswords was established, with one superintendent and one wing chief, under a deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 a Han firearms-and-broadsword camp was established under a deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 協領、參領，旗各一人，操練尉、驍騎校各五人。

translations.literal: One assistant banner commander and one regimental commander per banner; five drill commandants and five vanguard corporals each.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant banner commander and regimental commander per banner; five drill commandants and vanguard corporals each.

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in year 36.

sentences.zh: 三十年，始設火器營，置鳥槍護軍參領十有六人，以旗員兼任。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, the Firearms Battalion was first established with sixteen musket guard regimental commanders, filled concurrently by banner officials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 the Firearms Battalion was established with sixteen musket guard regimental commanders filled by banner officials.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年省察哈爾八旗護軍參領，改入本營為專缺。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, Chakhar Eight-Banner guard regimental commanders were abolished and absorbed into this camp as dedicated posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 Chakhar guard regimental commanders were absorbed as dedicated firearms posts.

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Qianlong, eight were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 eight were cut.

sentences.zh: 鳥槍驍騎參領二十有四人，乾隆二十八年省。

translations.literal: Twenty-four musket vanguard regimental commanders — abolished in the twenty-eighth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four musket vanguard regimental commanders were cut in Qianlong 28.

sentences.zh: 鳥槍驍騎校百十有二人，乾隆三十五年省入護軍校。

translations.literal: One hundred twelve musket vanguard corporals — in the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong absorbed into guard corporals.
translations.idiomatic: 112 musket vanguard corporals were absorbed into guard corporals in Qianlong 35.

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and ministers were specially chosen to lead.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, and ministers were appointed to lead.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十八年，改置營總、鳥槍護軍參領，旗各一人，副護軍參領各二人，委署護軍參領各四人，護軍校藍翎長各二十有八人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Qianlong, camp chiefs and musket guard regimental commanders were re-established — one per banner; two deputy guard regimental commanders each; four acting guard regimental commanders each; twenty-eight guard-corporal blue-plume chiefs each.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 camp chiefs and musket guard regimental commanders were re-established with expanded deputy, acting, and blue-plume quotas.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，以副護軍參領八人兼司砲位。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, eight deputy guard regimental commanders also managed artillery positions.
translations.idiomatic: In year 35 eight deputy guard regimental commanders also managed artillery.

sentences.zh: 先是置管砲散秩官五十六人。

translations.literal: Earlier, fifty-six ministers without portfolio managing artillery had been placed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier fifty-six ministers without portfolio had managed artillery.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十八年省，至是來隸。

translations.literal: Abolished in the twenty-eighth year of Qianlong; now they came under this command.
translations.idiomatic: Cut in Qianlong 28, they now came under this command.

translations.literal: One regular and one deputy wing chief were also added.
translations.idiomatic: One regular and one deputy wing chief were also added.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，遴護軍校十人為委署參領上行走。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, ten guard corporals were chosen as acting regimental commanders on upper duty.
translations.idiomatic: In year 38 ten guard corporals became acting regimental commanders on upper duty.

sentences.zh: 健銳營掌印總統大臣一人。

translations.literal: Valiant Camp — one seal-holding overall supervising minister.
translations.idiomatic: Valiant Camp: one seal-holding overall supervising minister.

translations.literal: Overall supervising ministers had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Overall supervising ministers had no fixed quota.

translations.literal: Held concurrently by princely ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Held by princely ministers.

sentences.zh: 翼長、委署翼長、前鋒參領各一人，副前鋒參領八人，正三品。

translations.literal: One wing chief, one acting wing chief, and one vanguard regimental commander each; eight deputy vanguard regimental commanders — regular third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One wing chief, one acting wing chief, one vanguard regimental commander, and eight deputy vanguard regimental commanders — regular third rank.

translations.literal: Deputy regimental commanders doubled — regular fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy regimental commanders doubled — regular fourth rank.

translations.literal: Acting regimental commanders doubled again.
translations.idiomatic: Acting regimental commanders doubled again.

translations.literal: Subordinate fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate fifth rank.

translations.literal: One hundred vanguard corporals — regular sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: 100 vanguard corporals — regular sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 副前鋒校四十人，前鋒內選用。

translations.literal: Forty deputy vanguard corporals, selected from vanguards.
translations.idiomatic: 40 deputy vanguard corporals chosen from vanguards.

translations.literal: Fifty blue-plume chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: 50 blue-plume chiefs.

translations.literal: Selected from guards.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen from guards.

sentences.zh: 番子佐領、防禦各一人，驍騎校二人，前鋒軍水師教習、委署千總、把總各四人。

translations.literal: One tribal company commander and one defense commandant, two vanguard corporals; four naval drill instructors and acting battalion and platoon chiefs each for the vanguard naval unit.
translations.idiomatic: One tribal company commander, one defense commandant, two vanguard corporals, and four naval drill and acting battalion and platoon chiefs.

translations.literal: Eight clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Eight clerks.

translations.literal: Coordinating secretaries had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinating secretaries had no fixed quota.

translations.literal: Appointed from this camp's regimental commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed from this camp's regimental commanders.

sentences.zh: 總統掌左、右翼健銳營政令，遴前鋒、護軍習雲梯者別為營，以時訓練其藝。

translations.literal: The overall supervisor managed left and right Valiant Camp government orders, selected vanguards and guards skilled in scaling ladders for a separate camp, and trained them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The overall supervisor managed the Valiant Camps, formed ladder-scaling units from vanguards and guards, and trained them on schedule.

translations.literal: At grand reviews they formed the wing rank.
translations.idiomatic: At grand reviews they formed the wing rank.

sentences.zh: 會外火器營交沖，並督水軍習戰。

translations.literal: They joined the outer Firearms Battalion in assault and also supervised naval troops in battle practice.
translations.idiomatic: They joined outer Firearms Battalion assaults and supervised naval battle practice.

translations.literal: Wing chiefs and other officers supervised and led camp soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Wing chiefs led camp soldiers.

translations.literal: The tribal company commander supervised tribal troops.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal company commander supervised tribal troops.

sentences.zh: 水師千、把掌教駕船駛風，演習水嬉。

translations.literal: Naval battalion and platoon chiefs taught sailing and wind handling and practiced water maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: Naval chiefs taught sailing and water maneuvers.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，設健銳營，駐香山，簡王大臣領之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong, the Valiant Camp was established at Fragrant Hills under a specially chosen princely minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 the Valiant Camp was established at Fragrant Hills under a princely minister.

sentences.zh: 分兩翼，置翼領各一人，八旗前鋒參領、副參領各一人，二十八年增前鋒參領二人，副參領八人。

translations.literal: Divided into two wings, with one wing leader each; one vanguard regimental and deputy regimental commander each per banner; in the twenty-eighth year two vanguard regimental commanders and eight deputy regimental commanders were added.
translations.idiomatic: Two wings were formed with wing leaders; vanguard regimental and deputy commanders per banner; Qianlong 28 added two regimental and eight deputy commanders.

sentences.zh: 三十五年簡前鋒參領二人為委翼長。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, two vanguard regimental commanders were chosen as acting wing chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 35 two vanguard regimental commanders became acting wing chiefs.

translations.literal: Five vanguard corporals each.
translations.idiomatic: Five vanguard corporals each.

sentences.zh: 十五年增十人，二十八年增二十四人，三十三年增二十六人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year ten were added; in the twenty-eighth year twenty-four; in the thirty-third year twenty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Added in year 15 (10), year 28 (24), and year 33 (26).

sentences.zh: 十五年，定昆明湖教水戰，置教習把總八人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Kunming Lake naval drill was fixed, with eight drill platoon chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 Kunming Lake naval drill was fixed with eight drill platoon chiefs.

sentences.zh: 內四人為委署千總，向天津、福建水師營調取。

translations.literal: Four served as acting battalion chiefs, transferred from Tianjin and Fujian naval camps.
translations.idiomatic: Four acted as battalion chiefs from Tianjin and Fujian naval camps.

sentences.zh: 十八年，置委前鋒參領十有六人，二十八年、五十年俱增八人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, sixteen acting vanguard regimental commanders were placed; eight more in the twenty-eighth and fiftieth years.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 sixteen acting vanguard regimental commanders were added; eight more in years 28 and 50.

translations.literal: Forty deputy vanguard corporals.
translations.idiomatic: 40 deputy vanguard corporals.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，增藍翎長五十人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, fifty blue-plume chiefs were added.
translations.idiomatic: In year 39 fifty blue-plume chiefs were added.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，金川番子徙京，置佐領、驍騎校各一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, Jinchuan tribesmen moved to the capital; one company commander and one vanguard corporal were placed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 41 Jinchuan tribesmen moved to the capital with one company commander and one vanguard corporal.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，增番子驍騎校、防禦各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, one tribal vanguard corporal and one defense commandant were added.
